archetypes.name: dyn-guideline-parser
archetypes.rationale: Checks the new architectural guideline entry parses and stays within evidence scope.
archetypes.prompt_body: Review the architectural guideline documentation change. Confirm the G-Root-1 heading matches the guideline parser format and appears in the intended section order. Check that the entry cites only the verified evidence issues and preserves the documented cwd exceptions. Cite specific file paths and line ranges for any issues found, and follow the output-format rules from your outer wrapper exactly.
